stream_key.description: Write-only secret. Required when creating stream_key outputs, optional on update to keep the existing encrypted key. Never returned by Control API, UI, logs, or audit metadata.

watch_url.description: YouTube watch or share URL for stream_key mode. The server validates supported YouTube hosts and video IDs, rejects credentials, fragments, and non-default ports, then stores a canonical watch URL. New UI-created profiles require it; the API keeps existing profiles without this field readable and updatable for compatibility.

oauth_account_id.description: Required for live_api and live_api_dry_run modes.

complete_on_stop.description: When true, Control Panel completes the YouTube Live broadcast during normal stream stop. Defaults to true when omitted.
